title: Wrapping up
html:
This week you met the argument for effective altruism and practised the first skill, reasoning transparency. Writing “I’m not sure” or “this is based on a vague memory” can feel awkward. Knowing which of your beliefs rest on little is what lets you fix them.

Next week you look at how charity evaluators work out what an intervention achieves per euro, and where their estimates are strong or weak.

Before the session

Notice one moment this week when you form a view about how to help others: a news story, a fundraising appeal, a conversation. Ask yourself what your reasoning is, how confident you are and what would change your mind. Come ready to share it.
